name: Righteous Smash
description: Your next melee swing strikes the target for weapon damage plus a bonus. Every hit grants a stack of Conviction.
assumptions: Bonus 14.3 + 2/level is Heroic Strike (9.5 + 1.4 L) about 30% better (Davis 2026-10-17). A landed hit adds 1 stack of Conviction; a miss, dodge or parry adds none. Vengeful Conviction's 2-stack empowerment waits on the on-block trigger.

name: Bulwark Charge
description: Charge an enemy, generating 15 Rage and leaving Consecration at the destination: for 8 sec, each second every enemy within 8 yd takes Holy damage. Usable in combat.
assumptions: 8-25 yd, 15 s cooldown, usable in combat (Davis 2026-10-17). Consecration placeholders (#103): radius 8 yd, a tick every 1 s for 8 s, 4 + 0.6/level Holy a tick, one patch per caster (a new one replaces the old). Centred where the charge ends. A tick cannot miss or crit and ignores armour.

name: Shield of the Penitent
description: For 10 sec your chance to Block is increased by 75%. Every block deals 30 Holy damage to the attacker.

name: Zealous Cleave
description: A sweeping attack that hits up to 3 targets in front of you for weapon damage plus a bonus. Consumes all Conviction stacks to add bonus Holy damage.
assumptions: Bonus 6.5 + 1.3/level is vanilla Cleave about 30% better (Davis 2026-10-17). Instant, not next-swing. Hits the target plus the two nearest other enemies within melee reach (5 yd) of the caster, in the front 180 degrees as vanilla Cleave; each target rolls its own outcome and damage. Placeholder: each Conviction stack adds 5 + 1/level Holy damage on every target the Cleave hits; the bonus cannot miss or crit. No stacks, no bonus.
